verses.1: And Solomon became king over all Israel.
verses.2: And these are the men who Azariah, son of Zadok, the priest, helped.
verses.3: Elihoref and Ahia, sons of Shishah. Yehoshaphat was the son of Ahilud, the priest.
verses.4: And his sons, the sons of Jehoiada, were responsible for the worship and sacrifices. They were also priests.
verses.5: And Azariah son of Nathan was the leader among the priests; and Zabud son of Nathan was the priest to the king.
verses.6: And they will build the house, and they will worship it as a god.
verses.7: And in Shlomo’s time, twenty-one kings ruled over all of Israel. They destroyed the king and his house every year. This would happen once a year as a tradition.
verses.8: And these names belong to Ben-Hur on Mount Epirus.
verses.9: In the valley of Dekker, in Shalvim and Bet Shemesh, and also in Beit Hanan.
verses.10: In his paths, there is mercy; and all the land is fertile.
verses.11: Son of Abinadab, every tribe of Dor was under his control. The daughter of Shlomo became his wife.
verses.12: In the land of Ben-Ahilud, you will be destroyed and all the houses in She’an will be ruined. From the land of Tzaratna, under Mizraim, from She’an to Avel Makhola, all will be destroyed.
verses.13: Ben-Gevor, son of Ramot Gilad, had a son named Yair. This son had a belt made of gold thread. In Gilad, there were fifty cities, all of which were large and prosperous, with pleasant smells.
verses.14: Ahinadav, son of Ido, from Machanayma.
verses.15: Ahimmeatz ben-Nafthali also took the daughter of Shlomo as a wife.
verses.16: In Anan, son of Hushey, in Ashir and Alot.
verses.17: Yehoshaphat, son of Paruach, in Issachar.
verses.19: Gever, son of Uri, in the land of Gilgalad, in the land of Sihon. He was king over the Amorites and also king over the Bashanites. He was also a governor who ruled over that land.
verses.20: Judea and Israel will be like a plague that affects the sea; they will eat and drink, and be joyful.
